function IsPrime(n: integer): boolean;
begin
  if n < 2 then
    Result := False
  else
  begin
    Result := True;
    foreach var prime in LPrimes do
      if Sqr(prime) > n then
        break
      else if n mod prime = 0 then
      begin
        Result := False;
        break
      end
  end
end;
